shortDescription: Shares of India's Happiest Minds Technologies NSE:HAPPSTMNDS fell 4.7% to 383.6 rupees on Tuesday after ITC NSE:ITC said its IT arm would acquire a 22.1% stake in the IT services provider.Shares of ITC jumped as much as 3.1% in morning trading.
